Emma (CEO): Quick weekly exec checkpoint — TL;DR: finish bare-metal runbook, hold Private GA if QA < 98% on perf, tighten SLA fallback policy. Main asks below.
Carlos (VP Eng): Ack. Bare-metal infra hit NIC firmware issue on rack-4 yesterday, patching now. ETA ~6h.
Raj (CTO): Firmware patch validated on staging; will push to canary tonight (2 nodes). If canary passes, plan full roll in a 4h window.
Priya (VP Ops): Ops will freeze noncritical capacity changes during roll. Updated oncall rota for the week.
Liam (Head PM): Product ask: for Private GA we need customer-facing comms + an 8-page FAQ by Thu EOD. Also need a short runbook excerpt for customers. @Asha can we confirm pilot budget?
Asha (Head Finance): Confirm budget up to $75k for pilot credits. Need signed MSA before we can bill.
Emma (CEO): Priorities this week: 1) Bare-metal runbook + canary pass, 2) Finalize SLA fallback thresholds and SLO breach plan, 3) Customer comms & legal signoffs. Who's blocking?
Carlos (VP Eng): Current blocker: legacy scheduler interacts poorly with node reboots. Workaround = drain + graceful restart. Patch landing in PR #482.
Raj (CTO): Kernel patch included in PR. Ops runbook snippet to be used during canary:
```
# drain node
rbctl drain node-17
# restart runtime
rbctl restart runtime-gpu
```
Priya (VP Ops): Ops will execute the runbook in staging at 10:30 PST and record logs/artifacts. Will post results here.
Liam (Head PM): I'll coordinate comms and start the FAQ draft now. Target to send first draft by 18:00 today.
Emma (CEO): Decision rule: if canary latency regression >15% OR QA pass rate <98% we delay GA by 1 week. Otherwise proceed with staged rollout. Final decision Fri 15:00 PST. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Carlos (VP Eng): Understood — will tag PR and standby for the call.
Asha (Head Finance): Quick finance ask: Ops to provide estimated SLA exposure if we tighten financial SLA terms. Ping me Wed COB.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for canary-group @ 1708457000
Emma (CEO): Thanks all — keep updates in this thread. Small wins count. :thumbsup:
